modelAssumptions: One US planning tractor under own authority, no personal leased-on use; quantity is a model unit, not actual carrier fleet inferred from service count
General freight dryvan, US tractor stays in US; no hazmat, reefer, oversize or Mexico endorsement claimed
Apply national clean-record transport power-unit mean to the reference tractor; no asset-age, Texas, deductible or stated-value match asserted
Cargo policy median is allocated wholly once to the sole US planning power unit; no statistical joint sample or negotiated bundle claimed
Liability and physical damage are represented once by the Progressive proxy; do not add Insureon auto or another tractor PD charge
Shared-box PD premium and MX cargo territorial continuity remain separate unresolved families; no box coverage inferred from a power-unit denominator
General premises liability and workers compensation belong to company and employer costs respectively, not an extra tractor-auto premium
Same planning premium in cash and asset-financed cases retains physical damage; this does not certify lender insurance terms or actual premium financing
Published premium expense is a benchmark model, not a complete itemized invoice; taxes, fees, limits and endorsements are not separately observed or set to zero
